# Stale Workspace Cleanup

The cleanup path must be explicit, dry-run by default, and safe for active workspaces.

context: Exercise the stale workspace cleanup workflow. Mark result.txt STALE-WORKSPACE-PASS only after both agents agree the safety behavior is correct.
